past.title: Island of Dr. Moreau Halloween Prefunk feat. The Flowtenders (Indie Rock/Blues/Soul from Portland, OR) LIVE @ The Lyons Den
past.excerpt:
Let’s party like animals! Join us at The Lyons Den in Seaside on Halloween for a special “Island of Dr. Moreau” themed prefunk party featuring deliciously strange cocktails, half-human creatures and live music from Portland indie/soul/blues band, The Flowtenders. Wear your fur, feathers, claws, laboratory coats or other delightfully bizarre creations and get lost on our island of beautiful oddballs. No embarrassing costume parades, but we’ll be giving away an awesome gift basket to the person or couple with the best Dr. Moreau inspired outfit.

The Flowtenders are fronted by American Idol alum Naomi Tatsuoka (bass/vox) and Waterfront Blues Fest veteran Josh Makosky (guitar/vox) who deliver a passionate and soulful collection of well-crafted soul, blues and rock tunes. They’ve been regular crowd favorites at the Starday Tavern, Montavilla Station and other fantastic venues throughout Oregon. Featuring gorgeous melodies, powerful songwriting and guitar prowess, The Flowtenders are an absolute joy to hear and they put on one heck of a show!

past.title: Heather Christie & The Starlettes (Indie Roots/Folk from Portland, OR) LIVE @ The Lyons Den
past.excerpt:
Portland, OR acoustic trio, Heather Christie & The Starlettes, are bringing their harmony-rich blend of indie roots and folk to The Lyons Den in Seaside. Featuring Heather Christie, Christina Balesky and Melissa “Mel” Rierson, these talented women put their voices front and center – framing Heather’s personal songwriting with layered harmonies and acoustic warmth. Raised in a Pacific Northwest family of musicians, Heather grew up around bluegrass jams and gospel singalongs, laying a foundation that carries into music equally at home with intimate storytelling and spirited folk-rock energy.

The Starlettes formed in spring 2024 and released their self-titled debut EP on Valentine’s Day 2026. Recorded live to tape in a Portland basement, its three songs, “Is This Love,” “Lay Me Down” and “The Day You Called Me Devil”, capture the group’s direct, personal approach. Heather’s broader catalog includes Are You Willing, Live and Love Road, while her performing career has taken her nationwide. Come settle in for an evening of heartfelt songs, intertwined voices and a little folk-rock magic to warm up your Friday night!

past.title: Eel Sallad (Indie Roots/Rock from Portland, OR) LIVE @ The Lyons Den
past.excerpt:
Oregon City indie Roots/Rock band, Eel Sallad, are bringing their “grungegrass” sound to The Lyons Den in Seaside. Fronted by dynamic vocalist and guitarist Dallas Lee (Eel Sallad backwards), their contemplative songwriting and passionate instrumentals set the backdrop for a soulful, high-energy performance you can't help but boogie to. Eel Sallad’s music spans everything from sultry ballads to audacious grunge anthems, delivered with a compelling stage presence that keeps audiences hooked from start to finish. Their music brings together blues, folk and indie rock - balancing the warmth of acoustic roots music with the punch of electric instruments and driving drums.

Their March 2026 album, Songs We’ve Been Singing, features twelve tracks, including “Muddy Boots,” “Sad Dog Howl,” “Dead To You” and “Letting Go,” following their 2023 EP, Farm To Fable. The band also appeared on the 2026 WAMA Pickersfest lineup, bringing their soulful Roots/Rock sound to the Northwest’s acoustic music community. Come ready for an evening of earthy melodies, raw emotion and enough grunge in your grass to get you moving!

past.title: Holus Bolus (Psychedelic Acoustic Rock from Portland, OR) LIVE @ The Lyons Den
past.excerpt:
Multi-instrumentalist Tom Boylan, performing as Holus Bolus, is bringing his one-man psychedelic acoustic rock show to The Lyons Den in Seaside. Armed with an acoustic guitar, a compact drum kit and an array of foot pedals, Holus Bolus builds songs live, recording and layering instrumental parts until a single performer becomes a swirling, full-band experience. His sound blends rhythmic strumming, rock energy, reggae grooves and spacey textures – creating music that feels both earthy and otherworldly. Watching each song take shape is part of the fun as one rhythm becomes a groove, another layer adds color, and suddenly the whole room is moving.

His 2024 studio album, Elephant Road, features ten tracks, including “Never Too Soon,” “Survive” and “From the Edge of the Stars.” His catalog also includes Possible Lives and Live from the Western Edge, which captures extended performances from venues across Oregon and Northern California. With years of touring throughout the West and Southwest, Holus Bolus turns a solo performance into an expansive musical adventure. Come watch the layers unfold as you lose yourself in the psychedelic grooves!

past.title: Chasing Ebenezer (World/Roots/Rock from Portland, OR) LIVE @ The Lyons Den
past.excerpt:
Portland, OR world folk-rock band, Chasing Ebenezer, are bringing their adventurous blend of roots music and global rhythms to The Lyons Den in Seaside. Fronted by husband-and-wife team Benjamin Sadler (vox, guitar) and Heidi Beth Sadler (vox, violin), their sound weaves fiery fiddle melodies, resonant slide guitar and danceable grooves with Americana, Celtic, African and Middle Eastern influences. Trading lead vocals and songwriting duties, the pair balance intricate arrangements with heartfelt storytelling – moving between haunting folk passages, bluesy grit and spirited rhythms.

Chasing Ebenezer’s second full-length studio album, Compass, expands that musical journey with hammer dulcimer, banjo and mandolin alongside their signature violin and guitar. Its songs explore justice, forgiveness and possibility through Celtic ballads, atmospheric instrumentals and African, Latin and Reggae-inspired beats. The band’s resume includes Northwest Folklife, Portland Winterfolk, and an appearance on KOIN’s “AM Extra”. Chasing Ebenezer put on a fantastic show and we’re grateful to have them back at The Lyons Den!

past.title: Seaside Jazz Night feat. Dinah Urell & The Rhythm Club (Jazz & Blues Standards) LIVE @ The Lyons Den
past.excerpt:
Join us at The Lyons Den in Seaside for an evening of live jazz and blues music with Astoria vocalist, Dinah Urell! Backed by local quartet, The Rhythm Club, Dinah is showcasing over two decades of bop, swing and Latin standards in a performance you won't forget. Featuring RJ Marx on tenor saxophone, Roxanne Hill on keys, Clarence Robinson on bass and Dusty Hill on drums, these talented musicians are dynamic and energetic – dazzling audiences with their melodic improvisations and deep knowledge of jazz music.

Dinah’s powerful voice echos the artistic bravado of Peggy Lee and soulfulness of Billie Holiday in a sound that is uniquely her own. She is the co-founder and publisher of HIPFiSH Monthly, and owner/manager of Astoria performance venue, KALA. Don’t miss this opportunity to see Dinah and The Rhythm Club in Seaside!
